video_title: LeBron James reacts to Anthony Edwards taking shots at him for not joining Minnesota 😂

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James addresses Anthony Edwards' comments about his knee health
quotes.excerpt: I love Ant to death, but I don't watch anything from the stripes.

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: How did you feel about Ant calling you out in his sneaker commercial just to kick the season off the right way?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: First of all, I did not watch the spot because I don't watch anything from the stripes. Nothing. I love Ant to death, but I don't watch anything from the stripes. I don't even know what he actually said. Obviously, you can see some of the headlines. I think it said he was too old, he didn't want his knees to be cold. But then I was like, I went to Philly, Ant. It's like my knees are going to be warmer in Philly. So, he did not edit some writing. He just read on the teleprompter. That was not good.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick and LeBron James discuss Victor Wembanyama's MVP candidacy

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: Moving to the Spurs, is this Wembanyama's MVP year?

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: Yeah, exactly. I mean, you could make the case last year. In my eyes, Wembanyama had a case for MVP last year because of the totality of how he affects the game. I think the difference is that we traditionally look at who closed the game for your team. Wembanyama can close games, but he is not necessarily a closer every night. Some nights he is, some nights it is not his thing.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Bill Russell and Victor Wembanyama as game closers
quotes.excerpt: Did he have the biggest impact in the game? That was the argument.

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: I am sure Bill Russell going back a long, long time wasn't always closing the game, but did he have the biggest impact in the game? That was the argument. Maybe what about the Dream?

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: Dream was closing. The ball is going into him in those days when we had everyone lifted, he had the double. If he is isolated, it is him, if not, he is making the plays.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Wembanyama faces tough competition from players like Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama is going against a guy named Shai who is super clutch, super efficient.

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: I do think Wembanyama, that is probably why he is going against a guy named Shai who is super clutch, super efficient, same with Joker. So the guys in that category are traditionally what we have been looking for. I mean, that is the argument.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: That is the argument to be had.

text_blocks.speaker: JJ Redick
text_blocks.text: But I do think everyone is getting more familiar with the impact Wembanyama has on the game, so it is not so much like, well, he wasn't making the shot at the end of the game every night. He just changes everything.
